name: Map Teleport
source: Fast & Furious only: holding X (or Y) on the world map travels to the map cursor with the game's own fast travel to a position (FastTravelModule 0x561d90, cost 0), in free roam; the patches are guards (each site's bytes are checked, nothing in them changes), the code swaps two vtable slots (MapScene's update, the button's closure invoke)
